  // Check if user wants to continue conversation
  isConversationContinuation(input) {
    const lowerInput = input.toLowerCase().trim();

    });

  // Smart promise detection based on response content
  detectAndSetPromise(responseText, category) {
    const promiseKeywords = {
      'work_study_balance': ['work-study balance', 'balanced work and study', 'maintained.*gpa.*working', 'perfect gpa.*full-time'],
      'academic_achievements': ['academic achievements', 'outstanding.*academic', 'dean.*list', 'top.*percent'],

      'professional_growth': ['professional growth', 'career development', 'leadership.*role']
    };
    
    // Detect which promise should be set based on the content of the response
    for (const [promiseKey, keywords] of Object.entries(promiseKeywords)) {
      for (const keyword of keywords) {
        const regex = new RegExp(keyword, 'i');
        if (regex.test(responseText)) {
          this.context.pendingPromise = promiseKey;

        }

    // Fallback: if educational content, default to work-study balance

      this.context.pendingPromise = 'work_study_balance';
    }
  }

      'when did', 'where did', 'why did', 'how does', 'what was',
      'really?', 'interesting', 'that sounds', 'wow', 'amazing'
    ];
    
    return followupPatterns.some(pattern => lowerInput.includes(pattern)) ||
           this.isConversationContinuation(input);
  }

  // Update conversation context for better continuity
  updateContext(category, userInput) {
    if (category && category !== 'continuation') {
      this.context.lastCategory = category;
      this.context.conversationDepth++;
      
      // Track topics of interest
      if (category && !this.context.userInterests.includes(category)) {
        this.context.userInterests.push(category);
      }
      
      // Update current topic context
      if (category !== this.context.currentTopic) {
        this.context.currentTopic = category;
        this.context.subtopics = [];
      }
      
      // Extract subtopics from user input
      const lowerInput = userInput.toLowerCase();
      const subtopicKeywords = {
        education: ['georgetown', 'masters', 'gpa', 'degree', 'university', 'study'],
        experience: ['shift', 'digital', 'analyst', 'promotion', 'clients', 'projects'],
        skills: ['python', 'sql', 'tableau', 'machine learning', 'technical', 'programming'],
        background: ['bangladesh', 'dhaka', 'culture', 'journey', 'america']
      };
      
      if (subtopicKeywords[category]) {
        subtopicKeywords[category].forEach(keyword => {
          if (lowerInput.includes(keyword) && !this.context.subtopics.includes(keyword)) {
            this.context.subtopics.push(keyword);
          }
        });
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Handle conversation continuation with smart context awareness

        'linkedin': "You can find Isfar on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/isfarbaset/. That's the best place to see her full professional profile and connect with her directly. Is there something specific about her background you'd like to know?",
        'hello': "Hi there! I'm IsBot, an AI assistant here to share insights about Isfar Baset's journey and work. You can ask me about her path so far in building a career in data science, her technical toolkit (Python, SQL, machine learning, NLP, cloud computing), education (MS in Data Science from Georgetown, BS in Computer Science), or her work experience and projects. Think of me as your guide if you're curious about her background, skills, or projects. Where would you like to start?",
        'hi': "Hi there! I'm here to share information about Isfar's background, experience, education, skills, and projects. What aspect of her professional story would you like to explore?",
        'hey': "Hey! Ready to learn about Isfar? I can tell you about her career, technical expertise, educational achievements, or impressive projects. What interests you most?"
      };
      
      if (singleWordResponses[word]) {
        return {
          response: singleWordResponses[word],
          category: 'single_word_' + word,
          score: 15,
          followups: []
        };
      }
    }
    
    // Check for specific quantitative questions (highest priority)
    if ((input.includes('how many years') || input.includes('years of')) && (input.includes('experience') || input.includes('work'))) {

This progression shows not just years of experience, but continuous growth and advancement in her field.",
        category: 'experience_years',

        followups: [

        ]
      };
    }
    
    if ((input.includes('how long') || input.includes('how much experience')) && (input.includes('working') || input.includes('work') || input.includes('experience'))) {
      return {
        response: "Isfar has been working in the technology field for about 5 years now, starting her professional journey in 2020. Her consistent growth and advancement show her dedication to continuous improvement and excellence in data science.",
        category: 'experience_duration',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          "Would you like to hear about her specific achievements during this time?",
          "Are you interested in learning about her career trajectory and growth?"
        ]
      };

    // Check for education duration questions
    if ((input.includes('how many years') || input.includes('years of')) && (input.includes('education') || input.includes('study') || input.includes('school'))) {
      return {
        response: "Isfar has dedicated 10 years to her higher education journey! She earned her Bachelor's in Computer Science from Grand Valley State University (2015-2020) - that's 5 years of undergraduate study. Then she pursued her Master's in Data Science & Analytics from Georgetown University (2023-2025) - another 2 years of graduate study, which she completed with an exceptional 4.0 GPA while working full-time. This represents a decade of continuous learning and academic excellence in STEM fields.",
        category: 'education_years',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          { text: "Would you like to know more about her academic achievements and work-study balance?", promise: "academic_achievements" },
          { text: "Are you curious about how she maintained a 4.0 GPA while working full-time?", promise: "work_study_balance" }
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for "why should I hire" or "why choose" questions
    if ((input.includes('why') && (input.includes('hire') || input.includes('choose') || input.includes('select') || input.includes('work with'))) ||
        (input.includes('what makes') && (input.includes('special') || input.includes('unique') || input.includes('stand out') || input.includes('different')))) {
      return {
        response: "What makes Isfar an exceptional data scientist is her unique combination of technical depth, practical impact, and continuous growth. She has nearly 5 years of professional experience delivering measurable results: 25% improvement in data accuracy across 10+ enterprise projects, 15 hours weekly saved through automation, and a near 100% customer approval rate. She brings a perfect 4.0 GPA from Georgetown's competitive Data Science program, expertise spanning Python, SQL, machine learning, NLP, cloud computing (AWS, Databricks), and big data processing. Her project portfolio demonstrates end-to-end capabilities - from processing 1+ billion Reddit posts to building production-ready AI assistants. Beyond technical skills, she brings a multicultural perspective, strong communication abilities (evidenced by her teaching and mentoring roles), and proven ability to translate complex technical work into business value. She's the rare professional who combines computer science fundamentals, advanced data science expertise, real-world impact, and leadership potential.",
        category: 'why_hire',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          { text: "Would you like to know more about her specific achievements and quantifiable impact?", promise: "professional_growth" },
          { text: "Are you curious about her technical expertise across the full data science stack?", promise: "technical_applications" }
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for availability/job seeking questions
    if ((input.includes('available') || input.includes('looking for') || input.includes('seeking') || input.includes('open to') || input.includes('interested in')) && 
        (input.includes('job') || input.includes('position') || input.includes('role') || input.includes('opportunity') || input.includes('work'))) {
      return {
        response: "For questions about Isfar's current availability and interest in new opportunities, I'd recommend connecting with her directly! You can reach out via email at isfar.baset@gmail.com or connect with her on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/isfarbaset/. She's based in Reston, VA and has experience with both remote and in-office work. With her recent completion of her Georgetown Master's degree (May 2025) and nearly 5 years of professional experience, she brings a strong combination of education and practical expertise. For specific discussions about roles, opportunities, or collaborations, direct outreach through email or LinkedIn is the best approach.",
        category: 'availability_opportunities',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          { text: "Would you like to know what types of roles align with her expertise?", promise: "professional_growth" },
          { text: "Are you curious about her technical skills and areas of specialization?", promise: "technical_applications" }
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for resume/CV questions
    if ((input.includes('resume') || input.includes('cv') || input.includes('curriculum vitae') || input.includes('download') || input.includes('pdf')) && 
        (input.includes('see') || input.includes('view') || input.includes('get') || input.includes('have'))) {
      return {
        response: "For Isfar's complete resume and portfolio materials, I'd recommend visiting her professional profiles! You can connect with her on LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/isfarbaset/ where her full professional background is available, or visit her portfolio website to see detailed project showcases, technical demonstrations, and downloadable materials. You can also reach out directly via email at isfar.baset@gmail.com if you'd like to request her resume for a specific opportunity. Meanwhile, I'm happy to answer any questions about her experience, education, skills, or projects right here!",
        category: 'resume_request',
        score: 15,
        followups: [
          { text: "Would you like me to summarize her key qualifications and achievements?", promise: "professional_growth" },
          { text: "Are you curious about specific aspects of her technical expertise or project experience?", promise: "technical_applications" }
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for salary/compensation questions (more variations)
    if ((input.includes('salary') || input.includes('compensation') || input.includes('pay') || input.includes('wage') || input.includes('income') || 
         input.includes('how much') && (input.includes('make') || input.includes('earn')) || input.includes('money')) &&
        !input.includes('save') && !input.includes('project')) {
      return {
        response: "I don't discuss compensation or salary information as that's personal and confidential. However, I'd be happy to share information about Isfar's professional value and achievements! She's delivered measurable business impact including 25% improvement in data accuracy, 15 hours weekly saved through automation, and streamlined operations for 12 high-value enterprise clients. With nearly 5 years of experience, a perfect 4.0 GPA from Georgetown, and expertise in high-demand skills (Python, SQL, machine learning, cloud computing, NLP), she brings significant professional value. For any discussions about specific opportunities, connecting directly via email (isfar.baset@gmail.com) or LinkedIn is best.",
        category: 'compensation_boundary',
        score: 20,
        followups: [
          { text: "Would you like to know about her professional achievements and measurable impact?", promise: "professional_growth" },
          { text: "Are you curious about her technical expertise and areas of specialization?", promise: "technical_applications" }
        ]
      };
    }
    
    // Check for specific multi-word phrases first (higher priority)
    const multiWordPhrases = {
      'educational background': 'education',
      'education background': 'education',
      'academic background': 'education',
      'school background': 'education',
      'university background': 'education',
      'work experience': 'experience',
      'professional experience': 'experience',
      'job experience': 'experience',
      'career experience': 'experience',
      'technical skills': 'skills',
      'programming skills': 'skills',
      'technology skills': 'skills',
      'cultural background': 'background',
      'personal background': 'background',
      'family background': 'background'
    };
    
    // Check for multi-word phrases first
    for (const [phrase, category] of Object.entries(multiWordPhrases)) {
      if (input.includes(phrase)) {
        return {
          response: this.knowledgeBase[category].response,
          category: category,
          score: 10, // High priority for exact phrase matches
          followups: this.knowledgeBase[category].followups
        };
      }
    }
    
    // Search through knowledge base with improved keyword matching
    Object.entries(this.knowledgeBase).forEach(([category, data]) => {
      let score = 0;
      let keywordMatches = 0;
      
      // Count keyword matches with better scoring
      data.keywords.forEach(keyword => {
        if (input.includes(keyword)) {
          keywordMatches++;
          // Give more weight to longer, more specific keywords
          if (keyword.length > 6) {
            score += 3;
          } else if (keyword.length > 4) {
            score += 2;
          } else {
            score += 1;
          }
        }
      });
      
      // Bonus for multiple keyword matches in same category
      if (keywordMatches > 1) {
        score += keywordMatches;
      }
      
      if (score > highestScore) {
        highestScore = score;
        bestMatch = data;
        matchedCategory = category;
      }
    });
    
    // Final safety check - if no meaningful match and score is very low, use professional boundary response
    if (highestScore < 2 && bestMatch) {
      return {
        response: "I'm here to provide information about Isfar's professional background, career achievements, and technical expertise. The question you've asked might be outside my area of focus. I'd be happy to share about her data science career, educational journey, technical skills, or professional experience. What specific aspect of her professional story would you like to learn about?",
        category: 'professional_boundary',
        score: 1,
        followups: [
          "Would you like to know about her career progression from Computer Engineer to Data Analyst II?",
          "Are you interested in her educational achievements and technical expertise?"
        ]
      };
    }
    
    return {
      response: bestMatch ? bestMatch.response : this.getFallbackResponse(),
      category: matchedCategory,
      score: highestScore,
      followups: bestMatch ? bestMatch.followups : []
    };
  }
  
  // Generate professional fallback responses
  getFallbackResponse() {
    const fallbacks = [
      "I'm designed to share information about Isfar's professional background, technical expertise, and career achievements. While I don't have specific details about that topic, I can tell you about her inspiring journey from Bangladesh to becoming a successful data scientist, her work at Shift Digital, or her academic excellence at Georgetown University. What aspect of her professional story would you like to explore?",
      "That's outside my area of expertise, but I have comprehensive knowledge about Isfar's professional journey, technical skills, and educational background. I can share insights about her data science career, her progression from Computer Engineer to Data Analyst II, or her impressive academic achievements. What interests you most?",
      "I focus specifically on Isfar's professional background and career accomplishments. While I can't address that particular question, I'd be happy to discuss her technical expertise, career growth, educational journey, or professional interests. Which aspect would you like to learn about?",
      "That question is outside my scope, but I excel at discussing Isfar's career trajectory, technical skills, educational achievements, and professional experience in data science. Would you like to know about her work at Shift Digital, her Georgetown Master's degree, or her transition into data analytics?"
    ];
    
    return fallbacks[Math.floor(Math.random() * fallbacks.length)];
  }
  
  // Check for inappropriate content
  isInappropriateContent(message) {
    const inappropriatePatterns = [
      /\b(phone|number|address|email|contact|personal|private)\b/i,
      /\b(date|dating|relationship|single|married|romantic)\b/i,
      /\b(sexy|hot|beautiful|attractive|looks|appearance)\b/i,
      /\b(help.*with|solve.*problem|homework|assignment)\b/i,
      /\b(money|salary|pay|wage|income)\b/i,
      /(.)\1{4,}/ // Repeated characters
    ];
    
    return inappropriatePatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(message));
  }
  
  // Get guardrail response
  getGuardrailResponse() {
    const responses = [
      "I'm here to share insights about Isfar's professional journey and achievements. Let's explore her career growth, technical expertise, or educational background. What aspect interests you most?",
      "Let's focus on Isfar's inspiring journey from Bangladesh to becoming a successful data analyst. I can share stories about her career progression, technical skills, or multicultural experiences. What would you like to discover?",
      "This conversation celebrates Isfar's professional achievements and personal interests. I can tell you about her work at Shift Digital, her academic excellence, or her creative hobbies. What sounds most intriguing?"
    ];
    
    return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
  }
  
  // Main response generation
  generateResponse(userInput) {
    try {
      this.messageCount++;
      
      // Input validation
      const sanitizedInput = userInput.trim();
      if (!sanitizedInput) {
        return "Please enter a message to continue our conversation!";
      }
      
      // Check for inappropriate content
      if (this.isInappropriateContent(sanitizedInput)) {
        return this.getGuardrailResponse();
      }
      
      // Find best response
      const match = this.findBestResponse(sanitizedInput);
      
      // Add conversation starters for more natural feel
      const starters = [
        "Great question! ",
        "I'd love to share that with you! ",
        "That's something Isfar is passionate about! ",
        "Interesting that you ask! ",
        "Here's what's fascinating about that: "
      ];
      
      const starter = starters[Math.floor(Math.random() * starters.length)];
      const response = starter + match.response;
      
      // Smart promise detection based on response content
      this.detectAndSetPromise(response, match.category);
      
      // Update conversation history and context
      this.conversationHistory.push({
        user: sanitizedInput,
        bot: response,
        category: match.category,
        followups: match.followups || [],
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        score: match.score || 0
      });
      
      // Update conversation context
      this.updateContext(match.category, sanitizedInput);
      
      // Keep conversation history manageable (last 10 exchanges)
      if (this.conversationHistory.length > 10) {
        this.conversationHistory = this.conversationHistory.slice(-10);
      }
      
      return response;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Chatbot error:', error);
      return "I apologize, but I encountered an issue. Please try asking your question again!";
    }
  }
}

// Initialize the chatbot
const chatbotAI = new IsfarChatbotAI();

// Message handling functions
function addMessage(content, isBot = false, withTyping = false) {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = `message ${isBot ? 'bot-message' : 'user-message'}`;
  
  const messageContent = document.createElement('div');
  messageContent.className = 'message-content';
  
  if (isBot && withTyping) {
    messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
    messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
    
    // Typing animation
    let i = 0;
    const typeWriter = () => {
      if (i < content.length) {
        messageContent.textContent += content.charAt(i);
        i++;
        messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
        setTimeout(typeWriter, 20 + Math.random() * 30);
      }
    };
    
    setTimeout(typeWriter, 300);
  } else {
    messageContent.textContent = content;
    messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
    messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  }
  
  return messageDiv;
}

function addTypingIndicator() {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'message bot-message typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="message-content"><div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
  messagesContainer.appendChild(typingDiv);
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  return typingDiv;
}

function removeTypingIndicator(typingDiv) {
  if (typingDiv && typingDiv.parentNode) {
    typingDiv.parentNode.removeChild(typingDiv);
  }
}

// Main message handling
function handleUserMessage(message) {
  if (!message.trim()) return;
  
  if (chatbotAI.isProcessing) return;
  
  chatbotAI.isProcessing = true;
  
  // Add user message
  addMessage(message, false);
  
  // Show thinking indicator
  const typingIndicator = addTypingIndicator();
  
  // Calculate realistic thinking time
  const thinkingTime = 800 + (message.length * 30) + (Math.random() * 600);
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      const response = chatbotAI.generateResponse(message);
      addMessage(response, true, true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Response error:', error);
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      addMessage("I apologize, but I encountered an issue. Please try again!", true);
    } finally {
      chatbotAI.isProcessing = false;
    }
  }, thinkingTime);
}

// Event listeners
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const chatInput = document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const sendButton = document.getElementById('send-button');
  const suggestionChips = document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-chip');
  
  function sendMessage() {
    const message = chatInput.value.trim();
    if (message && !chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
      handleUserMessage(message);
      chatInput.value = '';
    }
  }
  
  sendButton.addEventListener('click', sendMessage);
  
  chatInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  });
  
  chatInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const value = this.value.trim();
    sendButton.disabled = !value || chatbotAI.isProcessing;
    
    // Auto-resize textarea
    this.style.height = 'auto';
    this.style.height = Math.min(this.scrollHeight, 120) + 'px';
    
    // Ensure minimum height
    if (this.scrollHeight < 56) {
      this.style.height = '56px';
    }
  });
  
  suggestionChips.forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const question = this.textContent;
      if (!chatbotAI.isProcessing) {
        chatInput.value = question;
        setTimeout(() => sendMessage(), 100);
      }
    });
  });
  
  console.log('🚀 Advanced Isfar Chatbot initialized successfully!');
});
</script>

@keyframes typing {

.chat-input-container {

  background: #007AFF;
